text: 11-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing a mildly pruritic rash on her trunk and extremities for 2 days. One week ago, she developed symptoms of low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, and headache. A facial rash appeared 4 days later, sparing the perioral area.

speaker: Doctor
text: The progression from facial rash sparing the mouth to a trunk and extremity eruption is highly characteristic of erythema infectiosum, also known as Fifth Disease.
